# CadForge handoff

**Deliverable:** `CadForge.html` (identical copy `CadForge-Repaired.html`). It is generated by `build.ps1` from the source modules; edit the `.js` files and rebuild rather than editing the HTML.

## State

CadForge is a single-file browser CAD program with an AutoCAD-style interface: application menu and Quick Access Toolbar, workspace switch (Drafting & Annotation / 3D Modeling), tabbed ribbon, file tabs with a Start page, ViewCube / navigation bar / UCS icon, a command line with AutoComplete and AutoCAD prompts, dynamic input, a status bar with drafting aids and Model/Layout tabs, a Properties palette and a Layer Properties Manager. About 95 commands are registered with AutoCAD names and aliases (see README.md for the list).

All 56 automated checks pass (`node Verify.cjs`, details in Verification.txt) and the main flows were exercised in a browser with real clicks and key presses. The remaining known items are cosmetic and listed at the end of Verification.txt.

## Layout of the source

- Engine (unchanged behaviour): `core.js dialogs.js workspace.js advanced.js mesh.js compatibility.js csg-library.js booleans.js repairs.js profiles.js sheets.js`
- Workspace: `acad-core.js` (command registry `CF`, drafting-aid state, events, geometry helpers, theme) plus `acad-icons.js acad-commands.js acad-drafting.js acad-interact.js acad-views.js acad-palettes.js acad-shell.js`. Modules talk to each other only through `CF` at call time, so each one can be bundled and tested on its own.
- `shell.html` is the page template; `build.ps1` concatenates it with the modules in load order. `ui.js` is the superseded ribbon from the earlier build and is no longer bundled.
- Tests: `Verify.cjs` loads a bundle into a fake DOM and runs the engine checks, then every `tests/*.test.cjs` (each skips itself if its module is not bundled).

## Commands

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build.ps1                                   # CadForge.html + CadForge-Repaired.html
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build.ps1 -Include acad-core,acad-views -Out _dev\views.html   # partial bundle for one module
node Verify.cjs                  # test CadForge.html
node Verify.cjs _dev\views.html  # test another bundle
```

`_dev/` (scratch bundles) and `.claude/` (local preview settings) are git-ignored.

## Limits and ideas

Not implemented: DWG, plugins, parametric constraints, associative dimensions, true arc/spline entities, paper-space viewports, a B-rep kernel, polyline widths. Arcs, ellipses, fillets and hatches are polylines/line sets. DXF layer colours are written as the nearest AutoCAD Color Index. Not verified: real file downloads, `file://` loading, browsers other than the built-in one, interoperability with AutoCAD.
